C0162.title: Developing and Selling Game Cheats? Sheqi Court Sentences Defendants!
C0162.summary: From 2021 to 2022, the defendant Li developed a cheat program for the online game 'Assault Fire' and arranged its sale with Chen. The cheat provided unfair advantages and disrupted normal game operations.
